name: convexity_constraint

VINIT.justification: Initial void state before any points exist

TANCH.justification: Closed boundary containing all convex combinations

AFWD.justification: Forward transformation generating points within convex set

AREV.justification: Reverse check for segments exiting convex set

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-referential point invariant under convex combination

FSPLIT.justification: Splits set into convex and non-convex evaluation paths

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes original set from evaluation branches

EVALT.justification: Affirmative branch where all segments satisfy convexity

EVALF.justification: Negative branch where at least one segment violates convexity

ENGAGR.justification: Points simultaneously satisfying and challenging convexity criteria

IFIX.justification: Permanent record of convexity verification outcome

phase_3.true_description: Set where all segments between points lie entirely within the set
phase_3.false_description: Set containing at least one segment between points that exits the set
phase_3.both_description: Set with points ambiguously satisfying convexity under different decompositions

steps.domain_action: Form convex combination of points A and B
Confirm convexity if all segments valid
